observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black PlayStation 5 console with the PlayStation logo visible on the front. A white and black DualSense controller is placed in front of it. A coiled black cable is wrapped in plastic next to the console.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, revealing the black side panel with ventilation slots. The same controller and cable are visible. The console appears to be in a clean, well-lit environment.
The console has a disc drive visible on the side in photo 1, consistent with the PS5 model.
No FIFA game disc is visible in either photo.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or other accessories are shown in the photos.
The console's screen is off in both photos, and no game or disc is visible.

claims.evidence: No FIFA game disc is visible in either photo. No other accessories are shown. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game or disc.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have dead buttons/axis.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses and joystick movement.

risks.risk: The FIFA game disc may be missing or not included.
risks.proof: A photo of the FIFA game disc in its original packaging or a video showing the disc being inserted and recognized.

risks.risk: The console may have physical damage not visible in the photos, such as scratches, dents, or internal damage.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's surface and ports, and a video showing the console's internal components (if possible).

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and responding to inputs.
Photo of the FIFA game disc in its original packaging.
Close-up photo of the console's ports and surface for damage.
Photo of any included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
